I’m Lead Data Scientist at NHS Grampian & Senior Research Fellow at the University of Aberdeen.  

I run the University of Aberdeen and NHS Grampian’s [Networked Data Lab](https://www.health.org.uk/funding-and-partnerships/our-partnerships/the-networked-data-lab), a collaboration with The Health Foundation and four other NHS sites across the UK. This is a seven-year, seven-million-pound project aiming to reduce health inequalities.  

My team’s speciality is using high-security health and social care data to create useful analysis for policy makers.  

The Royal Statistical Society recently awarded us the [Florence Nightingale Award](https://rss.org.uk/news-publication/news-publications/2026/general-news/the-florence-nightingale-award-for-excellence-in-h/).
